title: Release blockers for 2.4 — Markdown in every part

payload.summary:
Three changes before **2.4** ships. Each one says what goes wrong and what the agent will do.

Accept the ones to apply; reject with a reason to skip one.

items.title: Retry card captures once on a gateway timeout
items.body:
A timeout from the gateway leaves the capture **unknown**: the money may or may not have moved.

The agent will:

1. look the capture up by its idempotency key;
2. retry only when the gateway has no record of it;
3. log both outcomes with the `capture_id`.

```elixir
def capture(charge) do
  case Gateway.capture(charge, timeout: 5_000) do
    {:error, :timeout} -> reconcile(charge)
    other -> other
  end
end
```

See the [gateway's guide](https://example.com/gateway/timeouts) for how keys work.

items.title: Add the refunds index on ledger_entries
items.body:
The refunds report scans the whole table, which takes **40 s** at month end.

```sql
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ledger_entries_refunds_idx
  ON ledger_entries (account_id, inserted_at)
  WHERE kind = 'refund';
```

> `CONCURRENTLY` keeps the table writable, but the migration must run outside a transaction.

items.title: Show the refund's status on the order page
items.body:
Support asks customers for screenshots because the page does not say whether a refund went through.

- *Pending* in grey
- *Refunded* in green, with the date
- *Failed* in red, with the gateway's reason

Run the page's tests with:

```sh
npm test -- order-page
```
